design_overview: UniStudy is designed as a modern, student-focused mobile application with clean navigation, intuitive information architecture, and collaborative features. The design prioritizes ease of use for browsing notes, joining study groups, and real-time communication. Visual hierarchy guides users through primary actions like uploading notes, searching content, and joining groups. The interface uses cards, lists, and clear CTAs to create a native mobile experience suitable for both iOS and Android.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen showing personalized overview of recent notes, active groups, and quick actions

key_components.name: Top Header
key_components.styling: White background with subtle shadow, contains greeting text 'Welcome back, [Name]' in bold heading font, and notification bell icon on right
key_components.interaction: Static greeting, bell icon navigates to notifications

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.styling: Rounded rectangle with light gray background, search icon on left, placeholder 'Search notes, groups...' in gray text
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens search screen with filters

key_components.name: Quick Stats Card
key_components.styling: White card with rounded corners and soft shadow, displays three columns: Notes Uploaded (number), Groups Joined (number), Downloads (number) with icons above each
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive informational display

key_components.name: Recent Notes Section
key_components.styling: Section header 'Recent Notes' in bold, followed by horizontal scrollable list of note cards with thumbnail, title, subject tag, and rating stars
key_components.interaction: Horizontal scroll, tapping card navigates to note detail screen

key_components.name: Active Groups Section
key_components.styling: Section header 'My Study Groups' in bold, vertical list of group cards showing group name, subject, member count, and last activity time
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to group chat screen

key_components.name: Upload Notes Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button with white text 'Upload Notes', rounded corners, plus icon on left, positioned above bottom navigation
key_components.interaction: Opens upload notes screen

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: White background with four icons: Home (filled), Notes, Groups, Profile, with labels below each icon
key_components.interaction: Tapping icons navigates to respective screens, active icon highlighted in primary blue

screens.user_flow: Entry point after login. Users can navigate to Notes, Groups, Profile via bottom nav, or use quick actions like Upload Notes or Search. Tapping recent notes or groups navigates to detail screens.

screens.name: Browse Notes
screens.purpose: Searchable and filterable library of all shared study notes with sorting and category options

key_components.name: Screen Header
key_components.styling: White background with title 'Study Notes' in bold heading font, back arrow on left, filter icon on right
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to Home, filter icon opens filter modal

key_components.name: Search Input
key_components.styling: Rounded input field with search icon, placeholder 'Search by title or subject...', light gray background
key_components.interaction: Typing filters notes in real-time

key_components.name: Subject Filter Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable row of pill-shaped chips: All, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, etc. Active chip has primary blue background
key_components.interaction: Tapping chip filters notes by subject

key_components.name: Sort Dropdown
key_components.styling: Small button with text 'Sort: Most Recent' and down arrow icon, light border
key_components.interaction: Opens dropdown with sort options: Most Recent, Highest Rated, Most Downloaded

key_components.name: Notes List
key_components.styling: Vertical scrollable list of note cards. Each card shows thumbnail image, title, subject tag, uploader name, rating stars, download count, and download button
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to note detail screen, tapping download button initiates download

key_components.name: Note Card
key_components.styling: White card with rounded corners, left side has document thumbnail, right side has title in bold, subject tag in small pill, uploader info, star rating, and download icon button
key_components.interaction: Tap card for details, tap download icon to download file

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered card with illustration, heading 'No notes found', subtext 'Try adjusting your filters or search terms'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive placeholder when no results

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: White background with four icons: Home, Notes (filled), Groups, Profile
key_components.interaction: Navigation between main sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Home via bottom nav or search. Users can filter by subject, sort by criteria, search by keywords, and tap notes to view details or download directly. Back button returns to Home.

screens.name: Note Detail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a single study note with preview, metadata, ratings, and download/share actions

key_components.name: Top Header
key_components.styling: White background with back arrow on left, share icon on right, title 'Note Details' centered
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to Browse Notes, share icon opens share sheet

key_components.name: Note Preview Image
key_components.styling: Full-width preview image of the note document with rounded corners, aspect ratio 16:9
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens full-screen preview

key_components.name: Note Title
key_components.styling: Bold heading text displaying note title, dark text color, left-aligned
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive text display

key_components.name: Metadata Card
key_components.styling: White card with rounded corners showing subject tag, uploader name with small avatar, upload date, file type, and download count in organized rows
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive informational display

key_components.name: Description Section
key_components.styling: White card with heading 'Description' and body text showing note description, expandable if long
key_components.interaction: Tap 'Read more' to expand full description

key_components.name: Rating Summary
key_components.styling: Card showing average rating with large star icons, total number of ratings, and 'Rate this note' button
key_components.interaction: Tapping 'Rate this note' opens rating modal

key_components.name: Reviews List
key_components.styling: Section header 'Reviews' followed by list of review cards showing user avatar, name, star rating, review text, and date
key_components.interaction: Scrollable list, non-interactive review cards

key_components.name: Download Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button with white text 'Download Note', full width, rounded corners, positioned above bottom nav
key_components.interaction: Initiates file download and increments download count

key_components.name: Bookmark Icon
key_components.styling: Floating bookmark icon in top right corner of preview image, toggles between outlined and filled
key_components.interaction: Tap to bookmark/unbookmark note for later

screens.user_flow: Accessed by tapping note card from Browse Notes or Home. Users can view details, read reviews, rate the note, download, share, or bookmark. Back button returns to previous screen.

screens.name: Study Groups
screens.purpose: Browse and join study groups, view active groups, and create new groups for collaborative learning

key_components.name: Screen Header
key_components.styling: White background with title 'Study Groups' in bold, search icon on right
key_components.interaction: Search icon opens group search modal

key_components.name: Tab Selector
key_components.styling: Two tabs: 'My Groups' and 'Discover', active tab has primary blue underline and text color
key_components.interaction: Tapping switches between user's groups and all available groups

key_components.name: Subject Filter Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable chips for filtering by subject: All, Math, Physics, CS, etc.
key_components.interaction: Tap to filter groups by subject

key_components.name: Group Card
key_components.styling: White card with rounded corners showing group name in bold, subject tag, description snippet, member count with user icon, admin name, and 'Join' or 'Open' button
key_components.interaction: Tapping card or button navigates to group chat if member, or shows join confirmation if not

key_components.name: Groups List
key_components.styling: Vertical scrollable list of group cards, each showing group info and action button
key_components.interaction: Scroll to browse, tap cards to view or join groups

key_components.name: Create Group Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue floating action button with plus icon, positioned bottom right above navigation
key_components.interaction: Opens create group modal with form fields

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered illustration with heading 'No groups yet' and subtext 'Create or join a study group to get started'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive placeholder when user has no groups

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: White background with four icons: Home, Notes, Groups (filled), Profile
key_components.interaction: Navigation between main sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Home via bottom nav. Users can switch between My Groups and Discover tabs, filter by subject, create new groups, or tap groups to join or open chat. Joining a group adds it to My Groups.

screens.name: Group Chat
screens.purpose: Real-time messaging interface for study group members to discuss topics and collaborate

key_components.name: Chat Header
key_components.styling: White background with back arrow on left, group name in center bold text, member count below in smaller gray text, settings icon on right
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to Study Groups, settings icon opens group settings modal

key_components.name: Message List
key_components.styling: Scrollable chat interface with messages aligned left (others) and right (user). Each message shows small avatar, sender name, message text in bubble, and timestamp
key_components.interaction: Scroll to view history, long-press message for options (if user's message)

key_components.name: User Message Bubble
key_components.styling: Right-aligned bubble with primary blue background, white text, rounded corners, timestamp below in small gray text
key_components.interaction: Long-press to edit or delete own messages

key_components.name: Other Message Bubble
key_components.styling: Left-aligned bubble with light gray background, dark text, small avatar on left, sender name above, rounded corners, timestamp below
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive display of other members' messages

key_components.name: Date Separator
key_components.styling: Centered small pill with light gray background showing date like 'Today' or 'Yesterday'
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive date marker

key_components.name: Message Input
key_components.styling: White background input field with rounded corners, placeholder 'Type a message...', plus icon on left for attachments
key_components.interaction: Tap to type message, plus icon opens attachment options

key_components.name: Send Button
key_components.styling: Circular primary blue button with white send icon, positioned right of message input
key_components.interaction: Tap to send typed message to group chat

key_components.name: Typing Indicator
key_components.styling: Small gray text above input showing '[Name] is typing...' with animated dots
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive real-time indicator

screens.user_flow: Accessed by tapping group card from Study Groups screen. Users can view message history, send new messages, attach files, and access group settings. Back button returns to Study Groups list.

screens.name: User Profile
screens.purpose: Personal profile showing user information, uploaded notes, joined groups, and account settings

key_components.name: Profile Header
key_components.styling: Gradient background (subtle primary to secondary) with user avatar centered, full name below in white bold text, university name in smaller white text, edit icon on top right
key_components.interaction: Edit icon opens profile edit screen

key_components.name: Stats Row
key_components.styling: White card below header with three columns: Notes Uploaded, Groups Joined, Total Downloads, each with number in bold and label below
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive stats display

key_components.name: Tab Selector
key_components.styling: Two tabs: 'My Notes' and 'Settings', active tab has primary blue underline
key_components.interaction: Switch between viewing uploaded notes and account settings

key_components.name: My Notes List
key_components.styling: Vertical list of note cards showing thumbnail, title, subject, upload date, downloads, and rating. Each card has edit and delete icons
key_components.interaction: Tap card to view note details, tap edit to modify, tap delete to remove

key_components.name: Settings List
key_components.styling: List of settings options: Account Info, Notifications, Privacy, Help & Support, Logout. Each row has icon on left, label, and chevron on right
key_components.interaction: Tap row to navigate to respective settings screen

key_components.name: Account Info Row
key_components.styling: White card row with user icon, 'Account Info' label, and right chevron
key_components.interaction: Navigate to account details screen

key_components.name: Logout Button
key_components.styling: Secondary outlined button with red text 'Logout', centered, rounded corners
key_components.interaction: Tap to logout and return to login screen

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: White background with four icons: Home, Notes, Groups, Profile (filled)
key_components.interaction: Navigation between main sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Home via bottom nav. Users can view their stats, browse uploaded notes, edit or delete notes, access settings, and logout. Edit icon navigates to profile edit screen.

ui_components.styling: White background with primary blue border (2px), primary blue text, rounded corners (8px), min-height 44px
ui_components.interaction: Tap to trigger secondary action, shows pressed state with light blue background

ui_components.name: Text Input Field
ui_components.styling: Light gray background (#F5F7FA), dark text, rounded corners (8px), padding 12px, placeholder in gray (#95A5A6), border appears on focus

ui_components.name: Content Card
ui_components.styling: White background, rounded corners (12px), soft shadow (0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)), padding 16px, clear visual hierarchy

ui_components.name: Icon Button

ui_components.name: Subject Tag
ui_components.styling: Small pill-shaped badge with secondary color background (#7B68EE), white text, padding 4px 12px, rounded corners (16px)

ui_components.name: Avatar
ui_components.styling: Circular image (32px or 48px), border with surface color, placeholder shows user initials on colored background

ui_components.name: Rating Stars
ui_components.styling: Row of 5 star icons, filled stars in warning color (#F39C12), empty stars in light gray, size 16px each

ui_components.name: Floating Action Button
ui_components.styling: Circular button (56px), primary blue background, white icon, elevated shadow, positioned bottom right with 16px margin

ui_components.name: Bottom Navigation Item

ui_components.interaction: Tap to navigate to section, shows active state immediately

responsive_design: The design uses a mobile-first approach optimized for screens 375px-428px width. Components scale proportionally on larger devices. Cards and lists use flexible layouts with max-width constraints. Bottom navigation remains fixed on mobile, adapts to side navigation on tablets. Typography scales using relative units. Touch targets maintain minimum 44x44px size across all breakpoints. Horizontal scrolling lists are touch-optimized with momentum scrolling.
accessibility: All interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 for text. Icons are paired with text labels. Form inputs include clear labels and placeholders. Error states use both color and text. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Keyboard navigation supported for web version. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Alternative text provided for all images.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability: button press shows 95% scale with 150ms ease-out, card tap shows subtle lift with shadow increase, page transitions use 300ms slide animation, bottom nav icons scale 110% on tap, loading states use skeleton screens with shimmer effect, message send shows slide-up animation, pull-to-refresh uses native elastic animation, modal appears with fade and slide-up (250ms), toast notifications slide from top with auto-dismiss.
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style for inactive states, filled style for active states. Icons include: home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash, share. All icons 24x24px default size, scalable to 20px (small) or 32px (large). Icons use currentColor to inherit text color for easy theming. Positioned with 8px padding for comfortable touch targets.
